records.name: Deep Trekker
records.description: Kitchener-based Canadian manufacturer of portable, battery-operated remotely operated vehicles for underwater inspection, reconnaissance, security, and public-safety missions.

capability.name: Rapid-deployment defence ROV systems
capability.summary: Portable battery-operated underwater ROV systems with camera, sonar, and positioning options for rapid underwater observation and inspection.
capability.alignmentSummary: Portable ROVs can extend visual and sonar inspection into confined or hazardous underwater environments while keeping operators at a safer stand-off distance.

source.title: Underwater ROVs for Military & Police Operations
source.excerpt: Deep Trekker describes portable battery-operated ROVs with sonar and USBL options for underwater reconnaissance, threat assessment, diver overwatch, port security, and vessel inspection.

records.name: Voyis
records.description: Waterloo-based Canadian subsea imaging company, now part of Kraken Robotics, providing underwater cameras, lighting, and laser-scanning systems for vehicle-based inspection and survey.

capability.name: Observer subsea imaging systems
capability.summary: Integrated high-resolution subsea camera and lighting systems that can pair with laser scanners for underwater inspection and survey data collection.
capability.alignmentSummary: High-resolution optical imaging can support underwater ISR when close-range identification, inspection, or documentation is required after initial detection.

source.title: Observer Imaging Systems
source.excerpt: Voyis describes high-resolution underwater imaging systems that combine subsea cameras, lighting, and compatibility with laser scanners for vehicle-based inspection and survey data collection.

records.name: RBR
records.description: Ottawa-based Canadian designer and manufacturer of oceanographic instruments for measuring water properties from deep-ocean to polar environments.

capability.name: Oceanographic sensor and logger portfolio
capability.summary: Canadian-built sensors and loggers for measuring temperature, depth, salinity, dissolved gases, pH, and other ocean and water-column parameters.
capability.alignmentSummary: Oceanographic measurements can provide environmental context for undersea sensing and operations, although mission-specific integration still requires validation.

source.title: RBR realtime sensors
source.excerpt: RBR presents Canadian-built oceanographic sensors that measure temperature, depth, salinity, dissolved gases, pH, and other parameters from deep ocean to polar environments.

records.name: International Submarine Engineering
records.description: Port Coquitlam-based Canadian underwater systems company designing autonomous and remotely operated vehicles for commercial, scientific, and military clients.

capability.name: Explorer AUV
capability.summary: Flexible long-range autonomous underwater vehicle platform with public evidence of extended unsupervised under-ice survey operation.
capability.alignmentSummary: A long-range AUV can extend underwater survey and collection reach, particularly where crewed access or continuous supervision is impractical.

source.title: Explorer AUV
source.excerpt: ISE describes Explorer as a flexible long-range autonomous underwater vehicle and cites a continuous unsupervised under-ice survey exceeding ten days and one thousand kilometres.

records.name: Ocean Sonics
records.description: Truro-area Nova Scotia company developing smart digital hydrophones and underwater acoustic monitoring systems with onboard processing, recording, and streaming capabilities.

capability.name: icListen Smart Hydrophones
capability.summary: Smart digital hydrophones for underwater acoustic monitoring, streaming, recording, array use, and onboard processing of sound data.
capability.alignmentSummary: Networked smart hydrophones can contribute passive acoustic data and local processing to an underwater awareness architecture.

source.title: Real Time Smart Digital Hydrophones
source.excerpt: Ocean Sonics describes icListen as a smart digital hydrophone for acoustic monitoring, streaming, recording, arrays, and onboard processing of underwater sound data.

records.name: SEAMOR Marine
records.description: Nanaimo-based Canadian manufacturer of durable inspection-class underwater ROVs, cameras, accessories, and modular systems for observation and underwater work.

capability.name: Inspection-class underwater ROVs
capability.summary: Canadian-built inspection-class underwater ROVs with integrated cameras, directional control, and modular accessories for observation and underwater work.
capability.alignmentSummary: Inspection-class ROVs can provide close-range visual awareness and payload access for underwater inspection in locations where diver exposure is undesirable.

source.title: SEAMOR Marine - Durable Inspection Class ROVs
source.excerpt: SEAMOR Marine presents Canadian-built inspection-class underwater ROVs with integrated cameras, directional control, modular accessories, and configurations for observation and underwater work.

records.name: SubC Imaging
records.description: Clarenville-based Canadian subsea imaging company providing cameras, lights, lasers, recording software, and remote systems for demanding underwater inspection and survey environments.

capability.name: Integrated subsea imaging systems
capability.summary: Canadian-engineered subsea cameras, lighting, lasers, DVR software, and remote imaging systems for inspections, surveys, and demanding underwater environments.
capability.alignmentSummary: Integrated subsea imaging can support identification and documentation within underwater ISR workflows after a target or infrastructure feature is located.

source.title: Subsea Imaging Cameras, Lights, and Lasers
source.excerpt: SubC Imaging presents Canadian-engineered subsea cameras, lighting, lasers, DVR software, and remote imaging systems for inspections, surveys, and demanding underwater environments.

records.name: Nautel Sonar
records.description: Nova Scotia-based Canadian sonar OEM developing products, subsystems, and complete wet-end hull-mounted and variable-depth sonar systems for naval applications.

capability.name: Naval sonar OEM systems and subsystems
capability.summary: Canadian sonar OEM products and subsystems spanning hull-mounted and variable-depth wet-end systems and support for naval underwater-warfare applications.
capability.alignmentSummary: Naval sonar systems and wet-end subsystems directly support underwater detection, localization, and tracking functions within an ISR architecture.

source.title: Homepage - Nautel Sonar
source.excerpt: Nautel Sonar describes Canadian sonar products and subsystems, including hull-mounted and variable-depth wet-end systems and long-term support for Royal Canadian Navy underwater-warfare systems.

records.name: JASCO Applied Sciences
records.description: Canadian underwater acoustics company providing instrumentation, real-time processing, detection and localization software, acoustic modelling, and defence-focused ocean systems engineering.

capability.name: Underwater acoustic defence systems and analytics
capability.summary: Integrated underwater acoustic instrumentation, detection and localization software, hydrophone arrays, and sonar-performance analysis for defence and security applications.
capability.alignmentSummary: Combined acoustic sensors and detection software can support persistent passive collection, localization, and analysis for underwater awareness.

source.title: Defence & Security
source.excerpt: JASCO describes underwater acoustic instrumentation, detection and localization software, Arctic hydrophone arrays, sonar-performance analysis, and components for Canadian naval anti-submarine-warfare upgrades.

records.name: Xeos Technologies
records.description: Dartmouth-based Canadian designer and manufacturer of oceanographic beacons, telemetry products, and sensors for locating, monitoring, and recovering equipment in marine environments.

capability.name: XMA-11K submersible Argos beacon
capability.summary: Fully submersible Argos beacon rated to eleven thousand metres for locating and recovering deep-ocean equipment after it returns to the surface.
capability.alignmentSummary: A deep-rated recovery beacon supports underwater system accountability and recovery, but its role is enabling support rather than primary ISR collection.

source.title: Totally Deep - XMA-11K Brochure
source.excerpt: Xeos documents a fully submersible Argos beacon rated to eleven thousand metres for locating and recovering deep-ocean equipment after it returns to the surface.

records.name: AML Oceanographic
records.description: Victoria-area Canadian ocean technology company designing and manufacturing swappable sensors, instruments, and deployment systems for oceanographic and hydrographic measurement.

capability.name: Swappable oceanographic sensors and profilers
capability.summary: Sensor, profiling, and moving-vessel systems for measuring sound velocity, conductivity, temperature, depth, turbidity, and other water-column properties.
capability.alignmentSummary: Water-column and sound-velocity measurements can improve environmental characterization for sonar and underwater survey operations, subject to mission-specific integration.

source.title: Home Page | AML Oceanographic
source.excerpt: AML Oceanographic presents Canadian sensor, profiling, and moving-vessel systems for sound velocity, conductivity, temperature, depth, turbidity, and other water-column measurements.

records.name: Sensor Technology Ltd.
records.description: Collingwood-based Canadian manufacturer of piezoelectric ceramic solutions, custom acoustic transducers, hydrophones, and underwater sensing systems for ocean and defence applications.

capability.name: Custom underwater acoustic sensors and systems
capability.summary: Canadian-built piezoelectric acoustic sensors, hydrophones, transducers, and customized systems for high-value aquatic and uncrewed-vehicle applications.
capability.alignmentSummary: Custom acoustic sensors and hydrophones can provide collection components for underwater detection, monitoring, and uncrewed-platform payloads.

source.title: Sensor Technology Ltd.
source.excerpt: Sensor Technology describes Canadian-built piezoelectric acoustic sensors and systems for high-value aquatic environments, including defence-prime and uncrewed-vehicle applications.
